host.label: Gateway IP Address
host.help: IP address of your Salus UGE600 gateway (e.g. 192.168.0.28)

euid.label: Gateway EUID
euid.help: Usually 0000000000000000 in local Wi-Fi mode or 16-character hex code from the gateway sticker

pollInterval.label: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.help: Interval between reading status from the gateway (min 10s, recommended 30s)
